messages.subject: Re: Error
messages.body_plain:
Hi, the issue is fixed:
The problem is with the function extracting data from the "watout.dat" file (it extract the wrong time series). Therefore, all simulations (that extract output from the watout.dat file) and used the version that are committed before today (12.3.2021) should be rerun. I am sorry for this mistake. The code has been updated in Github
https://github.com/tamnva/SWATshiny

messages.subject: Re: ERROR in RSWAT
messages.body_plain:
Hi, when you load RSWATObject.rds -> load observed data -> calculate objective function (when calculating objective function the tool cannot find the location of simulated data)

Solution: Change the working folder (step 1: General setting) to your working folder

Hope it helps
